full: Why does free shipping make you add one more thing? Your basket is 40. Shipping costs 6 but it's free from 50. Pay 46 as it is, or add a 10 item and pay 50. Four more and you get an item instead of a fee. In one retailer's data, threshold offers drove extra sales, but lost shipping revenue made them unprofitable there. So add only what you'd buy anyway. Sellers check the margin. Follow Wurbins to decode how brands sell.
